Question 8
?

Find f(x,y,z) such that ∇f(x,y,z)=F(x,y,z), where F(x,y,z)=(ln⁡y+1)i+(xy−z2)j−2yzk.

a
 f(x,y,z)=xyln⁡y+xz−z2+C
b
 f(x,y,z)=ln⁡y+xy−yz2+C
c
f(x,y,z)=xln⁡y+x−yz2+C
d
 f(x,y,z)=xln⁡y+xy+xz2+C
e
 f(x,y,z)=xzln⁡y+x2−yz2+C
Submit
